drums.description: 90s-style boom bap hip hop instrumental, The track features a prominent, dusty drum break with a heavy kick and a crisp, layered snare, A repetitive, jazzy electric bassline provides a melodic foundation, complemented by a soulful, filtered horn sample that appears periodically, A rhythmic record scratch effect is used as a transitional element, The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the drum loop and the bass, The tempo is 92 BPM in the key of G minor, The production has a warm, analog character with slight vinyl crackle and saturation on the drum bus Publish

bass.description: Funk-rock instrumental, The arrangement features a prominent, syncopated electric bass line playing a repetitive sixteenth-note groove, A clean electric guitar performs rhythmic, percussive muted strums and occasional staccato chords, The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat patterns, A distorted electric guitar enters later with sustained power chords and melodic lead lines, The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor Publish
